ticket_text: We've been getting error 500 responses from the dashboard for the past 4 hours. All users are seeing blank boards and the sync with our calendar integration is completely broken. Our team is unable to track client projects, and we've already missed two client meetings. We've tried refreshing, clearing cache, and restarting the app — nothing works. We're in a high-pressure client review week and this is completely blocking our workflow. Can you please take immediate action to resolve this? We're losing credibility with our clients and cannot operate without this feature.

The Northbeam platform has been down for over 60 minutes. All users are seeing a blank screen and unable to access any dashboards or perform actions. This has impacted our entire sales team's ability to close deals. We have no alternative tools and cannot proceed with client follow-ups.

I’d like to request a new feature that allows users to set custom alerts for project milestones. For example, I want to receive a notification when a deadline is missed or when a task is completed early. This would help me stay proactive in managing my team’s workload and improve responsiveness to changes.

The app has been crashing intermittently on our team's desktops over the past 30 minutes. We're seeing frequent browser crashes and blank dashboards when trying to view project timelines. We can still access the login page and view basic data, but the main workspace fails to load consistently. This is affecting our ability to track progress and communicate with clients. We're not seeing any login errors or payment failures. The issue started after a recent update to the app version, but we don't know if it's related to the update or a broader service issue.

Our app has been crashing every time we try to open the project dashboard. We've been getting error 500s and the dashboard is completely blank. This started happening two hours ago and it's affecting all team members. We're unable to access any reports or track progress. We've tried restarting, clearing cache, and switching browsers, but nothing helps. The billing team was just notified and we're now stuck with no visibility into client deliverables. Can you please fix this immediately?
The new dashboard reports are not working in the mobile app, but I’d love to see a dark mode option for better night-time use. Maybe we could also add a calendar sync with Google Calendar?
I need all my data exported, but the export button is broken and I can't find it in the settings. Also, I'm worried someone might have accessed my data recently.
I need all my team's data exported immediately — we're preparing for a merger and need access to historical project records, but the export link is broken and I can't find it in the UI.

Our invoice for March shows a duplicate charge, but we didn’t authorize it. I’ve tried contacting support twice and still can’t find a correction. It’s not our fault, and we’re now considering legal action. Can you please fix this and issue a refund immediately?

The app keeps crashing whenever I try to open the dashboard, and I've been unable to access any reports. I can still log in and see my team's data, but once I open the dashboard, it crashes immediately. I've tried clearing the cache and restarting the browser, but that didn't help. I'm not sure if this affects everyone or just me, but my team members have reported similar issues when opening the same view. I also noticed that the export function is not working, which is blocking our ability to generate invoices. I'm worried this might be related to a data sync issue or a bug in the UI. I'm not sure if this is a whole-team outage or just a personal issue, but the crashes are happening across multiple devices. I don't see any error messages, and the service is otherwise responsive. I just need to confirm whether this is a system-wide problem or just a user-level issue.

I've been using Northbeam for a few months now and I noticed that the team collaboration view doesn't support custom column filtering. It would be very helpful if we could filter by custom tags or statuses to make it easier to track tasks across departments. This would save us time during weekly planning meetings and improve visibility. I'm not sure if this feature already exists, so I wanted to check and ask if it's something the team might consider adding in a future update. I'm also not sure if there's a workaround right now, but I don't see any option in the current interface for filtering by tags or custom fields.

The Northbeam app is completely down — we can't log in or access any dashboards. Every user in our company is seeing a blank page and no error message. This has been going on for over an hour now. We’ve tried switching networks and browsers, but nothing works. Our entire sales team is blocked from accessing client data, and we’re unable to send invoices. We’re not sure if this is a login issue or a backend failure. We don’t have access to any internal logs or error messages from the service. Can you confirm if this is a service outage and when it might be resolved?
